# Sertuin Events

> Official first-party information about elopement weddings, private marriage proposals and event services in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

Sertuin Events is operated by Sertuin SRL, a registered Dominican company based in Punta Cana. The website pages linked below are the primary source for current published prices, inclusions, photographs, policies and booking information. Availability must always be confirmed directly with Sertuin Events.

## Punta Cana elopement packages

- [Punta Cana elopement packages](https://sertuinevents.com/punta-cana-elopement-packages/): Official English page with current experience prices, decoration prices, inclusions, legal wedding information, policies and frequently asked questions.
- [Paquetes de elopement en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/punta-cana-elopement-packages/): Official Spanish version of the same service.

### Published elopement facts

- The Private Beach Elopement base experience is US$999 and lasts up to two hours.
- The Private Catamaran Elopement base experience is US$1,299 and includes three hours aboard a completely private catamaran.
- The published catamaran price covers 2 to 10 people. The vessel has capacity for up to 60 people; groups above 10 require a custom quote.
- Both base experiences include private round-trip transportation for two from the Punta Cana area, a professional photographer, bouquet, boutonniere, officiant, coordination and a symbolic wedding certificate.
- The catamaran also includes snacks, fruit, sodas, water, rum, mamajuana, music and snorkeling.
- Couples receive 70 to 100 professionally edited, high-resolution photographs within 48 hours.
- One selected decoration is added to the base experience. Published decoration prices range from US$789 to US$1,399.
- Decorations use premium artificial Real Touch flowers. Every published decoration can be installed on the catamaran except the Full Tropical Huppa, which is available only on the private beach.
- Published package prices include a symbolic ceremony. A legal wedding service can be added for US$1,200 after the couple's documents are reviewed and accepted.
- The legal service includes receiving and reviewing documents, scheduling the civil registry appointment, collecting the marriage certificate, apostilling it and shipping the completed certificate.
- A US$200 PayPal deposit reserves the date after availability and the service agreement are confirmed. The deposit is credited to the total and is non-refundable under all circumstances.
- The remaining balance is paid in cash on the wedding day when arriving at the beach or before boarding the catamaran.
- If rain affects the selected time, Sertuin may change the ceremony time, use an available covered location or move the experience to a non-rainy day. Catamaran operation remains subject to the captain's safety decision.
- Sending an inquiry form does not reserve or confirm a date.

## Marriage proposal packages

- [Punta Cana proposal packages](https://sertuinevents.com/proposal/): Official English overview, current packages and prices, inclusions, reservation process, real work and frequently asked questions.
- [Propuestas de matrimonio en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/proposal/): Official Spanish version of the proposal service.

Proposal experiences take place on Sertuin Events' private beach in Uvero Alto. Published proposal prices include private round-trip transportation from the Punta Cana area, private beach access, the selected romantic setup, a celebratory beverage, professional photography, the client's preferred song and on-site coordination.
